meaning: Configure named visual variants and a positive edition size for each. A card copy is identified by collection, variant and serial number within that edition. At most one successful finalized mint may occupy each copy identity; other configured copies are intentional editions, not duplicates. Proposed v1 rule: freeze the collection manifest before its first mint; changed artwork or edition sizes require a new explicitly identified collection. A retry keeps the same card-copy identity and cannot consume another edition slot. An uncertain outcome blocks a replacement attempt for that copy until reconciliation establishes its outcome. A proven failure requires fresh confirmation. No automatic replacement transaction or remint of a successfully minted copy.
source_or_proposal: Revised local proposal with user-directed collectible variants; exact edition and transfer rules remain proposed.
